name: Shortage Analysis Agent
fn: Links PODs/BOLs, analyses shortage claims vs shipping records
detail: Aggregates packing lists, PODs and delivery proofs to test shortage claims against what actually shipped. Approves genuine shortages and denies the rest with evidence.
sap: SAP FSCM-DM · SD-TPM / Vistex programmes · FI-AR credit memo (FB75) · CO write-off postings
